answer: Locks are recorded in orchard, expire in wander, and relic lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 85 aliases as a result needs 113 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2891 identities would post 1176 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
